case_title: Uppala Bixam @ Bixmaiah v. The State of Andhra Pradesh
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302/201 IPC, life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that the deceased, a shepherd, took his 19 sheep for grazing but did not return home. On the following day, witnesses searching for the deceased found three sheep in possession of a person who claimed they were purchased from another individual, who in turn claimed they were obtained from the accused. The accused was arrested and a case was registered against him under Section 379 of the Indian Penal Code. During the investigation, the accused allegedly confessed to the crime, leading to a case under Sections 302 and 201 of the IPC. The dead body of the deceased was recovered from under a culvert based on the alleged confession. The Trial Court convicted the accused under Sections 302 and 201 and sentenced him to life imprisonment and six months' imprisonment, respectively. The High Court affirmed this conviction and sentence.
